title: Design the narrative/story beats (e.g., Hook → Character Development →…
content:
Design the narrative/story beats (e.g., Hook → Character Development → Investigation → The Hunt → Cliffhanger) before prompting in Seedance to guide scene structure and pacing.

Use a “master production blueprint” prompt that explicitly enforces seamless continuity across scenes (identical visual language, character appearance, environment, lighting, and cinematic style).

Add a dedicated STYLE block in your prompt with concrete cinematic descriptors (e.g., dark fantasy + grounded realism, volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field, natural color grading, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement) and include negative constraints like no text/subtitles/logos.

Lock character consistency by instructing Seedance to use provided character/creature references exactly as supplied and to never redesign or alter proportions, costumes, colors, personalities, or silhouettes.

Specify per-scene durations (e.g., 5s hook, 15s scenes) and describe the key beats and cliffhanger for each scene to control timing and narrative progression.

Include explicit CINEMATIC RULES in the prompt (motivated/dynamic camera movement, cinematic framing, natural pacing, realistic physics, expressive character animation) to steer shot language.

Constrain audio by prompting for no music and only environmental ambience/SFX (footsteps, breathing, rustling leaves, impacts, wind, distant creatures) for a more cinematic mix.

Request the output as multiple timestamped shots with camera direction, character actions, lighting, atmosphere, and sound design so Seedance returns a shot-by-shot plan that flows seamlessly.

es.content:
Diseña los beats narrativos/de la historia (p. ej., Hook → Character Development → Investigation → The Hunt → Cliffhanger) antes de hacer el prompt en Seedance para guiar la estructura de las escenas y el ritmo.

Usa un prompt de “master production blueprint” que imponga explícitamente una continuidad perfecta entre escenas (lenguaje visual idéntico, apariencia de los personajes, entorno, iluminación y estilo cinematográfico).

Añade un bloque STYLE dedicado en tu prompt con descriptores cinematográficos concretos (p. ej., dark fantasy + grounded realism, volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field, natural color grading, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement) e incluye restricciones negativas como no text/subtitles/logos.

Bloquea la consistencia de los personajes indicando a Seedance que use las referencias de personajes y criaturas proporcionadas exactamente como se entregan y que nunca rediseñe ni altere proporciones, vestuario, colores, personalidades o siluetas.

Especifica duraciones por escena (p. ej., hook de 5s, escenas de 15s) y describe los beats clave y el cliffhanger de cada escena para controlar el timing y la progresión narrativa.

Incluye reglas CINEMATIC explícitas en el prompt (motivated/dynamic camera movement, cinematic framing, natural pacing, realistic physics, expressive character animation) para orientar el lenguaje de plano.

Restringe el audio pidiendo que no haya música y solo ambience/SFX ambientales (footsteps, breathing, rustling leaves, impacts, wind, distant creatures) para lograr una mezcla más cinematográfica.

Solicita la salida como múltiples planos con timestamp, con dirección de cámara, acciones de los personajes, iluminación, atmósfera y diseño sonoro, para que Seedance devuelva un plan plano por plano que fluya sin interrupciones.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Thread 1] Antes de hacer el prompt, primero diseño la narrativa.

Story beats:
Hook → Character Development → Investigation → The Hunt → Cliffhanger.

La IA es solo la herramienta. La narración es el flujo de trabajo.

[Thread 2] MASTER PRODUCTION BLUEPRINT 

Create a premium cinematic AI short film with photorealistic quality, emotional storytelling, and seamless continuity. Every scene must feel like part of the same film, maintaining identical visual language, character appearance, environment, lighting, and cinematic style throughout.

STYLE
Dark fantasy, grounded realism, cinematic composition, premium VFX quality, volumetric lighting, natural color grading, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement, subtle atmosphere, no text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTER REFERENCES
Use the provided Character References and Creature References exactly as supplied. Never redesign, replace, or alter their proportions, costumes, colors, personalities, or silhouettes.

STORY OVERVIEW

HOOK (5s)
Open immediately with tension. The heroes are already running through a mysterious forest as if escaping something terrifying. The audience never sees the full threat—only glimpses of movement, shadows, and destruction. Just as they believe they've escaped, a colossal figure silently blocks their path. End on an unresolved cliffhanger.

SCENE 1 (15s)
Return to Oddville before the chase. Introduce the heroes naturally through playful interactions and peaceful daily life. Build emotional connection and establish each character's personality. Gradually introduce subtle signs that something is wrong—an unnatural silence, distant echoes, uneasy reactions from wildlife, and an ominous feeling surrounding the nearby forest. End with the group deciding to investigate.

SCENE 2 (15s)
The heroes enter the forest and begin following mysterious clues. They discover massive footprints, broken trees, deep claw marks, and evidence of an enormous creature moving through the woods. The tension escalates with fleeting silhouettes and unsettling sounds. At the climax, a gigantic pair of antlers slowly emerges through dense fog, revealing the presence of an ancient creature watching them.

SCENE 3 (15s)
The Antler King fully reveals itself. The heroes flee, but the forest becomes a trap as Hollow Hunters and Thorn Beasts surround them from every direction. Every escape route is blocked. At the moment of complete hopelessness, the crimson symbol on the Cow Leader's forehead begins glowing. Instantly, every creature freezes in absolute silence. The Cow slowly raises its head and stares directly at the Antler King. Neither moves.

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATIC RULES
Every scene must use dynamic camera language, motivated camera movement, cinematic framing, natural pacing, realistic physics, expressive character animation, and emotional storytelling. Preserve perfect continuity between every shot.

AUDIO
No music. Use only immersive environmental ambience, footsteps, breathing, distant creatures, rustling leaves, wood creaks, wind, impacts, and cinematic natural sound effects.

OUTPUT
Divide every sequence into multiple cinematic shots with precise timestamps, camera direction, character actions, lighting, atmosphere, and sound design. Every shot must naturally flow into the next, creating one seamless cinematic experience.
---

fr.content:
Concevez les beats narratifs/de l’histoire (par ex. Hook → Développement des personnages → Investigation → La chasse → Cliffhanger) avant de formuler le prompt dans Seedance afin de guider la structure des scènes et le rythme.

Utilisez un prompt de « master production blueprint » qui impose explicitement une continuité fluide entre les scènes (langage visuel identique, apparence des personnages, environnement, éclairage et style cinématographique).

Ajoutez un bloc STYLE dédié dans votre prompt avec des descripteurs cinématographiques concrets (par ex. dark fantasy + grounded realism, volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field, natural color grading, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement) et incluez des contraintes négatives comme no text/subtitles/logos.

Verrouillez la cohérence des personnages en demandant à Seedance d’utiliser les références de personnages/créatures fournies exactement telles qu’elles sont, et de ne jamais redessiner ni modifier les proportions, costumes, couleurs, personnalités ou silhouettes.

Précisez des durées par scène (par ex. hook de 5 s, scènes de 15 s) et décrivez les beats clés ainsi que le cliffhanger de chaque scène afin de contrôler le timing et la progression narrative.

Incluez des CINEMATIC RULES explicites dans le prompt (mouvement de caméra motivé/dynamique, cadrage cinématographique, rythme naturel, physique réaliste, animation expressive des personnages) pour orienter le langage des plans.

Contraignez l’audio en demandant aucune musique et uniquement une ambiance/SFX environnementaux (pas, respiration, bruissement des feuilles, impacts, vent, créatures au loin) pour un mix plus cinématographique.

Demandez une sortie sous forme de plusieurs plans horodatés avec direction de caméra, actions des personnages, éclairage, atmosphère et sound design afin que Seedance renvoie un plan plan par plan qui s’enchaîne de manière fluide.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Avant de formuler le prompt, je conçois d’abord l’histoire.

Story beats :
Hook → Développement des personnages → Investigation → La chasse → Cliffhanger.

L’IA n’est qu’un outil. Le storytelling est le workflow.

[Thread 2] MASTER PRODUCTION BLUEPRINT 

Créez un court-métrage IA cinématographique premium avec une qualité photoréaliste, une narration émotionnelle et une continuité fluide. Chaque scène doit donner l’impression de faire partie du même film, en conservant tout au long du projet un langage visuel identique, l’apparence des personnages, l’environnement, l’éclairage et le style cinématographique.

STYLE
Dark fantasy, grounded realism, composition cinématographique, qualité VFX premium, volumetric lighting, natural color grading, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement, atmosphère subtile, no text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTER REFERENCES
Utilisez les Character References et Creature References fournis exactement tels qu’ils sont. Ne redessinez, ne remplacez ni ne modifiez jamais leurs proportions, costumes, couleurs, personnalités ou silhouettes.

STORY OVERVIEW

HOOK (5s)
Ouvrez immédiatement sur la tension. Les héros courent déjà à travers une forêt mystérieuse, comme s’ils fuyaient quelque chose de terrifiant. Le public ne voit jamais la menace dans son intégralité — seulement des aperçus de mouvement, d’ombres et de destruction. Alors qu’ils pensent avoir échappé au danger, une silhouette colossale bloque silencieusement leur chemin. Terminez sur un cliffhanger non résolu.

SCENE 1 (15s)
Retournez à Oddville avant la poursuite. Présentez les héros naturellement à travers des interactions ludiques et une vie quotidienne paisible. Créez un lien émotionnel et établissez la personnalité de chaque personnage. Introduisez progressivement des signes subtils indiquant que quelque chose ne va pas — un silence anormal, des échos lointains, des réactions inquiètes de la faune et une sensation menaçante autour de la forêt voisine. Terminez avec le groupe qui décide d’enquêter.

SCENE 2 (15s)
Les héros entrent dans la forêt et commencent à suivre des indices mystérieux. Ils découvrent d’immenses empreintes, des arbres brisés, de profondes marques de griffes et des preuves qu’une créature gigantesque a traversé les bois. La tension monte avec des silhouettes fugitives et des sons inquiétants. Au climax, une paire d’immenses bois émerge lentement d’une brume dense, révélant la présence d’une créature ancienne qui les observe.

SCENE 3 (15s)
L’Antler King se révèle pleinement. Les héros fuient, mais la forêt devient un piège lorsque les Hollow Hunters et les Thorn Beasts les encerclent de toutes parts. Toutes les issues sont bloquées. Au moment d’un désespoir total, le symbole cramoisi sur le front du Cow Leader commence à briller. Instantanément, toutes les créatures se figent dans un silence absolu. La Cow lève lentement la tête et fixe directement l’Antler King. Aucun des deux ne bouge.

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATIC RULES
Chaque scène doit utiliser un langage de caméra dynamique, un mouvement de caméra motivé, un cadrage cinématographique, un rythme naturel, une physique réaliste, une animation expressive des personnages et une narration émotionnelle. Préservez une continuité parfaite entre chaque plan.

AUDIO
Pas de musique. Utilisez uniquement une ambiance immersive, des pas, la respiration, des créatures au loin, le bruissement des feuilles, des craquements du bois, le vent, des impacts et des effets sonores naturels cinématographiques.

OUTPUT
Divisez chaque séquence en plusieurs plans cinématographiques avec des timestamps précis, la direction de caméra, les actions des personnages, l’éclairage, l’atmosphère et le sound design. Chaque plan doit s’enchaîner naturellement avec le suivant, créant une expérience cinématographique unique et fluide.

ja.content:
---
Seedanceでプロンプトを入力する前に、物語のビート（例：Hook → Character Development → Investigation → The Hunt → Cliffhanger）を設計し、シーン構成とテンポを導く。

シーン間のシームレスな連続性（視覚言語、キャラクターの見た目、環境、ライティング、シネマティックなスタイルがすべて同一であること）を明確に強制する「master production blueprint」プロンプトを使う。

プロンプト内に専用のSTYLEブロックを追加し、具体的なシネマティック描写（例：dark fantasy + grounded realism、volumetric lighting、shallow depth of field、natural color grading、realistic textures、dynamic camera movement）を入れ、さらに no text/subtitles/logos のようなネガティブ制約も含める。

Seedanceに、提供されたキャラクター／クリーチャーの参照をそのまま正確に使用し、プロポーション、衣装、色、性格、シルエットを決して再設計・変更しないよう指示して、キャラクターの一貫性を固定する。

シーンごとの尺（例：5秒のhook、15秒の各シーン）を明記し、各シーンの主要なビートとcliffhangerを記述して、タイミングと物語の進行をコントロールする。

ショット言語を誘導するために、プロンプト内で明示的なCINEMATIC RULES（motivated/dynamic camera movement、cinematic framing、natural pacing、realistic physics、expressive character animation）を含める。

音声は、音楽なしで、環境音とSFXのみ（足音、呼吸、葉擦れ、衝撃音、風、遠くのクリーチャーなど）にするよう指定し、よりシネマティックなミックスにする。

カメラの指示、キャラクターの動き、ライティング、雰囲気、サウンドデザインを含む、タイムスタンプ付きの複数ショットとして出力を依頼し、Seedanceがショットごとのプランを返し、それがシームレスにつながるようにする。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] プロンプトを入力する前に、まず物語を設計する。

Story beats:
Hook → Character Development → Investigation → The Hunt → Cliffhanger.

AIはあくまでツール。ストーリーテリングがワークフローだ。

[Thread 2] MASTER PRODUCTION BLUEPRINT 

プレミアムなシネマティックAI短編映画を、フォトリアルな品質、感情のあるストーリーテリング、そしてシームレスな連続性で作成する。すべてのシーンが同じ映画の一部として感じられるようにし、全編を通して視覚言語、キャラクターの見た目、環境、ライティング、シネマティックなスタイルを完全に統一する。

STYLE
ダークファンタジー、グラウンデッド・リアリズム、シネマティックな構図、プレミアムVFX品質、ボリューメトリックライティング、自然なカラーグレーディング、浅い被写界深度、リアルな質感、ダイナミックなカメラワーク、控えめな雰囲気、文字なし、字幕なし、ロゴなし。

CHARACTER REFERENCES
提供されたCharacter ReferencesとCreature Referencesを、そのまま正確に使用すること。プロポーション、衣装、色、性格、シルエットを決して再設計、置換、変更しないこと。

STORY OVERVIEW

HOOK (5s)
冒頭から緊張感を一気に立ち上げる。ヒーローたちは、まるで何か恐ろしいものから逃げているかのように、すでに謎めいた森の中を走っている。観客には脅威の全貌は見せず、動きの断片、影、破壊の痕跡だけを見せる。逃げ切れたと思った瞬間、巨大な存在が静かに進路を塞ぐ。未解決のcliffhangerで終える。

SCENE 1 (15s)
追跡の前、Oddvilleに戻る。遊び心のあるやり取りと穏やかな日常を通して、ヒーローたちを自然に紹介する。感情的なつながりを築き、それぞれのキャラクターの個性を確立する。徐々に、何かがおかしいという微かな兆候を入れる——不自然な静けさ、遠くのこだま、野生動物の落ち着かない反応、そして近くの森を取り巻く不吉な気配。最後は、グループが調査を決意するところで終える。

SCENE 2 (15s)
ヒーローたちは森に入り、謎めいた手がかりを追い始める。巨大な足跡、折れた木々、深い爪痕、そして巨大なクリーチャーが森を移動した痕跡を発見する。緊張は、ちらつくシルエットと不穏な音でさらに高まる。クライマックスでは、濃い霧の中から巨大な一対の角がゆっくりと現れ、彼らを見つめる古代のクリーチャーの存在が明らかになる。

SCENE 3 (15s)
Antler Kingが完全に姿を現す。ヒーローたちは逃げるが、森は罠と化し、Hollow HuntersとThorn Beastsが四方八方から彼らを取り囲む。逃げ道はすべて塞がれる。完全な絶望の瞬間、Cow Leaderの額にある深紅のシンボルが光り始める。瞬時に、すべてのクリーチャーが絶対的な静寂の中で凍りつく。Cowはゆっくりと頭を上げ、Antler Kingをまっすぐ見つめる。どちらも動かない。

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATIC RULES
すべてのシーンで、ダイナミックなカメラ言語、motivated camera movement、シネマティックなフレーミング、自然なテンポ、リアルな物理挙動、表情豊かなキャラクターアニメーション、感情のあるストーリーテリングを用いること。すべてのショット間で完璧な連続性を保つこと。

AUDIO
音楽なし。没入感のある環境音、足音、呼吸、遠くのクリーチャー、葉擦れ、木のきしみ、風、衝撃音、そしてシネマティックな自然音のみを使用すること。

OUTPUT
各シーケンスを、正確なタイムスタンプ、カメラの指示、キャラクターの動き、ライティング、雰囲気、サウンドデザインを含む複数のシネマティックショットに分割すること。各ショットは自然に次のショットへつながり、ひとつのシームレスなシネマティック体験を形成すること。
---

ko.content:
---
Seedance에 프롬프트를 넣기 전에, 장면 구조와 템포를 이끌 수 있도록 내러티브/스토리 비트(예: Hook → Character Development → Investigation → The Hunt → Cliffhanger)를 먼저 설계하세요.

장면 간 완벽한 연속성(동일한 비주얼 언어, 캐릭터 외형, 환경, 조명, 시네마틱 스타일)을 명시적으로 강제하는 “master production blueprint” 프롬프트를 사용하세요.

프롬프트에 구체적인 시네마틱 묘사(예: dark fantasy + grounded realism, volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field, natural color grading, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement)를 담은 전용 STYLE 블록을 추가하고, no text/subtitles/logos 같은 네거티브 제약도 포함하세요.

제공된 캐릭터/크리처 레퍼런스를 그대로 정확히 사용하고, 비율, 의상, 색상, 성격, 실루엣을 절대 재설계하거나 변경하지 말라고 지시해 캐릭터 일관성을 고정하세요.

장면별 지속 시간(예: 5초짜리 hook, 15초짜리 장면)을 지정하고, 각 장면의 핵심 비트와 cliffhanger를 설명해 타이밍과 서사 진행을 제어하세요.

프롬프트에 명시적인 CINEMATIC RULES를 포함해 동기 부여된/동적인 카메라 움직임, 시네마틱 프레이밍, 자연스러운 페이싱, 현실적인 물리, 표현력 있는 캐릭터 애니메이션을 통해 샷 언어를 유도하세요.

음악은 사용하지 말고, footsteps, breathing, rustling leaves, impacts, wind, distant creatures 같은 환경 앰비언스/SFX만 사용하도록 오디오를 제한해 보다 시네마틱한 믹스를 만드세요.

카메라 방향, 캐릭터 행동, 조명, 분위기, 사운드 디자인이 포함된 여러 개의 타임스탬프가 있는 샷으로 출력해 달라고 요청하여, Seedance가 매끄럽게 이어지는 샷별 플랜을 반환하도록 하세요.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 프롬프트를 넣기 전에, 먼저 내러티브를 설계합니다.

Story beats:
Hook → Character Development → Investigation → The Hunt → Cliffhanger.

AI는 도구일 뿐입니다. 스토리텔링이 워크플로우입니다.

[Thread 2] MASTER PRODUCTION BLUEPRINT 

프리미엄 시네마틱 AI 단편 영화를 포토리얼한 퀄리티, 감정적인 스토리텔링, 그리고 매끄러운 연속성을 갖추어 제작하세요. 모든 장면은 같은 영화의 일부처럼 느껴져야 하며, 전체적으로 동일한 비주얼 언어, 캐릭터 외형, 환경, 조명, 시네마틱 스타일을 유지해야 합니다.

STYLE
Dark fantasy, grounded realism, cinematic composition, premium VFX quality, volumetric lighting, natural color grading, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement, subtle atmosphere, no text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTER REFERENCES
제공된 Character References와 Creature References를 그대로 정확히 사용하세요. 절대 재설계하거나, 대체하거나, 비율, 의상, 색상, 성격, 실루엣을 변경하지 마세요.

STORY OVERVIEW

HOOK (5s)
즉시 긴장감으로 시작하세요. 주인공들은 이미 무언가 끔찍한 존재에게서 도망치듯 신비로운 숲을 달리고 있습니다. 관객은 위협의 전체 모습을 보지 못하고, 움직임의 흔적, 그림자, 파괴의 단편만 보게 됩니다. 막 도망쳤다고 믿는 순간, 거대한 형체가 조용히 그들의 앞길을 가로막습니다. 해결되지 않은 cliffhanger로 끝내세요.

SCENE 1 (15s)
추격 이전의 Oddville로 돌아갑니다. 장난스러운 상호작용과 평화로운 일상을 통해 주인공들을 자연스럽게 소개하세요. 감정적 연결을 쌓고 각 캐릭터의 성격을 확립하세요. 점차 미묘한 이상 징후를 도입합니다. 부자연스러운 침묵, 멀리서 들려오는 메아리, 야생동물의 불안한 반응, 그리고 인근 숲을 둘러싼 불길한 기운이 그것입니다. 마지막에는 무리가 조사하기로 결정하며 끝내세요.

SCENE 2 (15s)
주인공들은 숲에 들어가 신비로운 단서를 따라가기 시작합니다. 그들은 거대한 발자국, 부러진 나무들, 깊은 발톱 자국, 그리고 거대한 생물이 숲을 지나간 흔적을 발견합니다. 긴장감은 스쳐 지나가는 실루엣과 불안한 소리로 점점 고조됩니다. 클라이맥스에서는 거대한 뿔 한 쌍이 짙은 안개 사이로 천천히 모습을 드러내며, 그들을 지켜보는 고대 존재의 존재를 드러냅니다.

SCENE 3 (15s)
Antler King이 완전히 모습을 드러냅니다. 주인공들은 도망치지만, 숲은 함정이 되어 Hollow Hunters와 Thorn Beasts가 사방에서 그들을 포위합니다. 모든 탈출로가 막힙니다. 완전한 절망의 순간, Cow Leader의 이마에 있는 진홍색 문양이 빛나기 시작합니다. 즉시 모든 생물이 절대적인 침묵 속에서 얼어붙습니다. Cow는 천천히 고개를 들어 Antler King을 똑바로 바라봅니다. 둘 다 움직이지 않습니다.

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATIC RULES
모든 장면은 동적인 카메라 언어, 동기 부여된 카메라 움직임, 시네마틱 프레이밍, 자연스러운 페이싱, 현실적인 물리, 표현력 있는 캐릭터 애니메이션, 감정적인 스토리텔링을 사용해야 합니다. 모든 샷 사이의 완벽한 연속성을 유지하세요.

AUDIO
음악은 사용하지 마세요. 몰입감 있는 환경 앰비언스, 발소리, 숨소리, 멀리서 들려오는 생물의 소리, 나뭇잎 스치는 소리, 나무가 삐걱거리는 소리, 바람, 충돌음, 그리고 시네마틱한 자연 사운드 이펙트만 사용하세요.

OUTPUT
각 시퀀스를 정확한 타임스탬프, 카메라 방향, 캐릭터 행동, 조명, 분위기, 사운드 디자인이 포함된 여러 개의 시네마틱 샷으로 나누세요. 모든 샷은 자연스럽게 다음 샷으로 이어져, 하나의 매끄러운 시네마틱 경험을 만들어야 합니다.
---

pt.content:
Projete os beats narrativos da história (por exemplo, Hook → Desenvolvimento de Personagem → Investigação → A Caçada → Cliffhanger) antes de fazer o prompt no Seedance, para orientar a estrutura das cenas e o ritmo.

Use um prompt de “master production blueprint” que imponha explicitamente continuidade perfeita entre as cenas (linguagem visual idêntica, aparência dos personagens, ambiente, iluminação e estilo cinematográfico).

Adicione um bloco STYLE dedicado no seu prompt com descritores cinematográficos concretos (por exemplo, dark fantasy + grounded realism, volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field, natural color grading, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement) e inclua restrições negativas como sem texto/legendas/logos.

Trave a consistência dos personagens instruindo o Seedance a usar as referências de personagens e criaturas fornecidas exatamente como estão, e a nunca redesenhar ou alterar proporções, figurinos, cores, personalidades ou silhuetas.

Especifique a duração de cada cena (por exemplo, hook de 5s, cenas de 15s) e descreva os beats principais e o cliffhanger de cada cena para controlar o timing e a progressão narrativa.

Inclua regras CINEMATIC explícitas no prompt (movimento de câmera motivado/dinâmico, enquadramento cinematográfico, ritmo natural, física realista, animação expressiva dos personagens) para orientar a linguagem dos planos.

Restrinja o áudio pedindo sem música e apenas ambiência/SFX do ambiente (passos, respiração, folhas se movendo, impactos, vento, criaturas distantes) para uma mixagem mais cinematográfica.

Solicite a saída como múltiplos planos com timestamp, direção de câmera, ações dos personagens, iluminação, atmosfera e design de som, para que o Seedance retorne um plano plano a plano que flua perfeitamente.

--- CONTINUAÇÃO DO THREAD ---
[Thread 1] Antes de fazer o prompt, eu primeiro desenho a narrativa.

Beats da história:
Hook → Desenvolvimento de Personagem → Investigação → A Caçada → Cliffhanger.

IA é apenas a ferramenta. Storytelling é o fluxo de trabalho.

[Thread 2] MASTER PRODUCTION BLUEPRINT 

Crie um curta-metragem AI cinematográfico premium com qualidade fotorrealista, narrativa emocional e continuidade perfeita. Cada cena deve parecer parte do mesmo filme, mantendo ao longo de tudo a mesma linguagem visual, aparência dos personagens, ambiente, iluminação e estilo cinematográfico.

STYLE
Dark fantasy, grounded realism, composição cinematográfica, premium VFX quality, volumetric lighting, natural color grading, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement, atmosfera sutil, sem texto, sem legendas, sem logos.

CHARACTER REFERENCES
Use as Character References e Creature References fornecidas exatamente como estão. Nunca redesenhe, substitua ou altere suas proporções, figurinos, cores, personalidades ou silhuetas.

STORY OVERVIEW

HOOK (5s)
Abra imediatamente com tensão. Os heróis já estão correndo por uma floresta misteriosa como se estivessem fugindo de algo aterrorizante. O público nunca vê a ameaça por completo — apenas vislumbres de movimento, sombras e destruição. No momento em que acreditam ter escapado, uma figura colossal bloqueia silenciosamente o caminho. Termine em um cliffhanger sem resolução.

SCENE 1 (15s)
Volte para Oddville antes da perseguição. Apresente os heróis de forma natural por meio de interações brincalhonas e da vida cotidiana pacífica. Construa conexão emocional e estabeleça a personalidade de cada personagem. Introduza gradualmente sinais sutis de que algo está errado — um silêncio anormal, ecos distantes, reações inquietas da fauna e uma sensação sinistra ao redor da floresta próxima. Termine com o grupo decidindo investigar.

SCENE 2 (15s)
Os heróis entram na floresta e começam a seguir pistas misteriosas. Eles descobrem pegadas gigantes, árvores quebradas, marcas profundas de garras e evidências de uma criatura enorme se movendo pela mata. A tensão aumenta com silhuetas fugazes e sons perturbadores. No clímax, um par gigantesco de chifres emerge lentamente através da neblina densa, revelando a presença de uma criatura antiga observando-os.

SCENE 3 (15s)
O Antler King se revela por completo. Os heróis fogem, mas a floresta se torna uma armadilha quando Hollow Hunters e Thorn Beasts os cercam de todos os lados. Todas as rotas de fuga são bloqueadas. No momento de completa desesperança, o símbolo carmesim na testa do Cow Leader começa a brilhar. Instantaneamente, todas as criaturas congelam em silêncio absoluto. O Cow lentamente ergue a cabeça e encara diretamente o Antler King. Nenhum dos dois se move.

CORTE PARA PRETO.

CINEMATIC RULES
Cada cena deve usar linguagem de câmera dinâmica, movimento de câmera motivado, enquadramento cinematográfico, ritmo natural, física realista, animação expressiva dos personagens e narrativa emocional. Preserve a continuidade perfeita entre todos os planos.

AUDIO
Sem música. Use apenas ambiência imersiva do ambiente, passos, respiração, criaturas distantes, folhas se movendo, rangidos de madeira, vento, impactos e efeitos sonoros naturais cinematográficos.

OUTPUT
Divida cada sequência em múltiplos planos cinematográficos com timestamps precisos, direção de câmera, ações dos personagens, iluminação, atmosfera e design de som. Cada plano deve fluir naturalmente para o próximo, criando uma experiência cinematográfica única e contínua.

zh.content:
在 Seedance 中开始提示之前，先设计叙事/故事节拍（例如：Hook → Character Development → Investigation → The Hunt → Cliffhanger），以引导场景结构和节奏。

使用一个“master production blueprint”提示，明确强制跨场景的无缝连续性（完全一致的视觉语言、角色外观、环境、光照和电影风格）。

在提示中加入一个专门的 STYLE 区块，使用具体的电影化描述词（例如：dark fantasy + grounded realism、volumetric lighting、shallow depth of field、natural color grading、realistic textures、dynamic camera movement），并加入负面约束，如 no text/subtitles/logos。

通过指示 Seedance 严格按所提供的角色/生物参考来使用角色一致性，且绝不重新设计或改变比例、服装、颜色、个性或轮廓，从而锁定角色一致性。

为每个场景指定时长（例如：5s hook、15s scenes），并描述每个场景的关键节拍和 cliffhanger，以控制节奏和叙事推进。

在提示中加入明确的 CINEMATIC RULES（有动机/动态的镜头运动、电影化构图、自然节奏、真实物理、富有表现力的角色动画），以引导镜头语言。

通过提示不要音乐，只保留环境氛围/SFX（脚步声、呼吸声、树叶沙沙声、撞击声、风声、远处生物声），来约束音频，以获得更具电影感的混音。

要求输出为多个带时间戳的镜头，并包含镜头方向、角色动作、光照、氛围和声音设计，这样 Seedance 就会返回一个逐镜头的计划，并且流畅衔接。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 在开始提示之前，我先设计叙事。

Story beats:
Hook → Character Development → Investigation → The Hunt → Cliffhanger.

AI 只是工具。讲故事才是工作流。

[Thread 2] MASTER PRODUCTION BLUEPRINT 

Create a premium cinematic AI short film with photorealistic quality, emotional storytelling, and seamless continuity. Every scene must feel like part of the same film, maintaining identical visual language, character appearance, environment, lighting, and cinematic style throughout.

STYLE
Dark fantasy, grounded realism, cinematic composition, premium VFX quality, volumetric lighting, natural color grading, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, dynamic camera movement, subtle atmosphere, no text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTER REFERENCES
Use the provided Character References and Creature References exactly as supplied. Never redesign, replace, or alter their proportions, costumes, colors, personalities, or silhouettes.

STORY OVERVIEW

HOOK (5s)
Open immediately with tension. The heroes are already running through a mysterious forest as if escaping something terrifying. The audience never sees the full threat—only glimpses of movement, shadows, and destruction. Just as they believe they've escaped, a colossal figure silently blocks their path. End on an unresolved cliffhanger.

SCENE 1 (15s)
Return to Oddville before the chase. Introduce the heroes naturally through playful interactions and peaceful daily life. Build emotional connection and establish each character's personality. Gradually introduce subtle signs that something is wrong—an unnatural silence, distant echoes, uneasy reactions from wildlife, and an ominous feeling surrounding the nearby forest. End with the group deciding to investigate.

SCENE 2 (15s)
The heroes enter the forest and begin following mysterious clues. They discover massive footprints, broken trees, deep claw marks, and evidence of an enormous creature moving through the woods. The tension escalates with fleeting silhouettes and unsettling sounds. At the climax, a gigantic pair of antlers slowly emerges through dense fog, revealing the presence of an ancient creature watching them.

SCENE 3 (15s)
The Antler King fully reveals itself. The heroes flee, but the forest becomes a trap as Hollow Hunters and Thorn Beasts surround them from every direction. Every escape route is blocked. At the moment of complete hopelessness, the crimson symbol on the Cow Leader's forehead begins glowing. Instantly, every creature freezes in absolute silence. The Cow slowly raises its head and stares directly at the Antler King. Neither moves.

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATIC RULES
Every scene must use dynamic camera language, motivated camera movement, cinematic framing, natural pacing, realistic physics, expressive character animation, and emotional storytelling. Preserve perfect continuity between every shot.

AUDIO
No music. Use only immersive environmental ambience, footsteps, breathing, distant creatures, rustling leaves, wood creaks, wind, impacts, and cinematic natural sound effects.

OUTPUT
Divide every sequence into multiple cinematic shots with precise timestamps, camera direction, character actions, lighting, atmosphere, and sound design. Every shot must naturally flow into the next, creating one seamless cinematic experience.
